sql:
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.name, l.milliseconds 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN results res ON d.driverId = res.driverId 
JOIN lapTimes l ON res.raceId = l.raceId AND d.driverId = l.driverId 
JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId 
WHERE l.milliseconds = (
    SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) 
    FROM lapTimes lt 
    JOIN results r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId AND lt.driverId = r.driverId
)
GROUP BY d.driverId, res.raceId
